native_evaluation.methodology: 457 controlled transformations, six public widget value/flag checks, three public canonical-field checks, one independently verified public UserUnit-only edit, and 32 selected natural-revision assertions over five pairs. Passing assertions include review exit code 3. Not exhaustive precision/recall.
native_evaluation.completion_scope: CLI/API coverage classification only. SDK mapping-error flags require review on changed sources. Default 8111 fixes the verified ToUnicode override defect; full Unicode correctness and reading order remain unproven.
native_evaluation.physical_dpi_coverage_change: Seven existing UserUnit=3 comparisons now require review because correct 144DPI output exceeds the 16000000-pixel bitmap cap. The prior release ignored UserUnit. See results-user-unit-coverage.json.
native_evaluation.process_supervision: Supervised CLI has exact recorded pass/summary/diagnostic/exit-code parity on all 499 v13 cases: results-byte-worker-parity.json. Typed byte fidelity is independently gated on 701 differential operations: results-isolated-bytes.json.

character_conservation.methodology: Multiset conservation vs direct Pdfium scalar stream, with recognized SDK hyphens restored and SDK-invalid controls/whitespace represented as U+FFFD; NFC, Latin ligature/long-s expansion and whitespace/control/soft-hyphen filtering. Direct SDK flags are also checked against IR metadata. This validates conservation and diagnostic transport, not original Unicode correctness.
character_conservation.diagnostic_inventory_qualification: results-unicode-diagnostics-sdk8111.json remains the v9 diagnostic inventory; current extraction audit reasserts all-page direct SDK/IR diagnostic count equality.

browser_runtime.methodology: All-page text, geometry, UserUnit and SDK diagnostic parity on 49 public PDFs; first-page PNG; 24 painted projection cases; 40 shared fixtures and robustness/limit checks. Public UserUnit=72 PDF has declared 612x792 physical-point and 72DPI PNG gold. Shared fixtures test UserUnit-only geometry/raster changes, invalid units and extreme physical raster limits. Not complete interactive/Unicode/raster equivalence. Native parity side now runs through the supervised CLI. WASM remains in-process in its browser context; this gate does not establish worker termination or a browser memory ceiling. Added valid deep canonical-action regression; not complete action semantics.

checks.rust_unit_integration_doctests: passed: 138 regular unit/integration/doctests, including typed byte parity/options/limits/protocol/cleanup and anonymous-file/depth guards. One subprocess helper is invoked by supervisor tests and ignored by ordinary discovery.
checks.public_corpus_tests: passed: 5 over 49 normal and 10 robustness sources, including physical UserUnit gold and full path/byte/text-layer parity.
checks.clippy: passed: current default and bundled all-targets -D warnings
checks.wasm_build: Current release probe built and all 128 Chrome cases passed; current payload hash recorded above. Browser-worker resource isolation remains unverified.
checks.runtime_bootstrap: Current default/bundled cold concurrent startup and same-size cache corruption repair pass under process supervision. SDK install uses an OS file lock, which is released if a worker exits. Other shared archive/library verification and WASM provisioning gates remain unchanged.
checks.npm_lockfile: npm ci passed; pdfjs-dist 6.4.299 exact pin, audit reports zero known vulnerabilities
checks.workflow_yaml: Parsed with Ruby Psych. CLI and typed-byte public-corpus audits configured with report artifacts. Remote workflow not dispatched.
checks.remote_ci: not dispatched; Linux gate remains unverified
checks.native_profile: release optimized for full native/independent/browser matrix; dev debug=0 and incremental disabled for Rust tests
checks.bundled_sdk_tests: passed: full current regular unit/integration/doctest suite, 138; includes typed byte protocol, anonymous staging and supervisor fault/recovery gates.
checks.cold_sdk_cache_tests: passed on current supervised CLI: 1 default cold concurrent download/corruption-repair test plus 1 bundled cold concurrent startup/corruption-repair test.

readiness.evidence: Ubuntu native test gate with fontconfig and CJK fallback fonts added; not executed in this macOS session.
Five official IRS W-4/W-9 revision pairs with 32 selected alignment/change/addition/removal/invariant checks. Exhaustive independent labels and precision/recall remain missing.

144DPI physical rasters, bounded SDK widgets and logical AcroForm records with per-property availability. 40 browser fixtures, nine independently checked public form mutations, 138 regular Rust tests and the full 138-test bundled suite pass. All 14 public form inventories and 47 supported values match pypdf. XFA semantics, full interactive and independent visual correctness remain incomplete.

Native 48 and browser 24 independently painted renders verified within 1px, including rotations, shifted/inherited boxes and UserUnit=3. Physical DPI now incorporates units while fixed-width projection preserves its requested pixel width. Crop-origin regression passes on all 49 public documents.

All seven options have externally observable tests. Checked APIs reject invalid values. text_change_score recovery implemented. Budget exhaustion is explicit and does not silently force unscored matches. Raw diff_documents requires already validated inputs. Four visual options (DPI, total pixels, channel tolerance, source image pixels) have validation and observable-effect tests.

All 59 pinned sources pass supervised IR success/explicit-rejection checks. All five opt-in IsolatedPdfClient methods preserve direct results over 701 byte operations, including all normal-page text layers, first-page width/DPI PNGs, IR and comparisons. PDF parsing/rendering/serialization run in disposable children with time, monitored-memory and output budgets. Anonymous input/capture files and explicit operation-directory cleanup are verified. Fault gates cover timeout/memory/output/crash/reaping/parent death/publication and typed protocol/cleanup/recovery. Existing direct APIs and WASM remain in-process. macOS/Windows polling can overshoot; Linux/Windows execution and portable hard memory enforcement remain unverified. Not a filesystem/network sandbox or aggregate host resource bound.

Page-local UserUnit, raw-coordinate metadata, physical_size_points, physical DPI and point-based tolerances implemented. Independently pinned public UserUnit=72 document has 8.5x11 raw units, 612x792 physical points and native/Chrome 72DPI pixels. Unit-only edit detected where prior release missed it. Unknown units require review; extreme raster sizes remain guarded. Parser analysis caps and floating-point/renderer limits apply; no arbitrary PDF equivalence claimed.

Default native, bundled native and browser WASM now use verified SDK 8111. Exact public full-page Unicode and independent CMap fixtures confirm override precedence, including a Unicode-only edit with unchanged painting. Independent inventory improves to 40 agreement / 8 disagreement / 1 resource-limited documents. SDK flags 117 glyphs over six pages; printable fallbacks remain and flagged separators are visible, but original Unicode recovery and full reading order remain incomplete. The additional agreement is a textless UserUnit regression source, not resolution of another Unicode discrepancy.

geometry_evaluation.native_oracle: Actual PNG pixels plus Pdfium PageToDevice API
geometry_evaluation.browser_oracle: Canvas reads PNG pixels; DOMMatrix applies public coefficients
geometry_evaluation.conditions: Four rotations; inherited boxes; nonzero, negative and 100000-unit origins; fractional dimensions; CropBox/MediaBox intersection; UserUnit=3 with physical-DPI and fixed-width rendering.
geometry_evaluation.limits: Projection to the current Pdfium renderer within 1px for the declared fixtures; floating-point/bitmap and parser analysis caps remain, not arbitrary-coordinate or source equivalence.
geometry_evaluation.regressions: Crop-origin edits, furniture-only/textless matching, duplicate-page crop and UserUnit ties, legacy OCR JSON defaults/validation, unknown-unit review and physical render limits.

native_engine.provenance: Current immutable supervised CLI loaded the pinned SDK in its worker, confirmed with DYLD_PRINT_LIBRARIES; installed library SHA-256 revalidated. Caller-provided SDK overrides remain outside this qualification.

page_count_regression.before_fix: IR silently contained 1 page (reproduced before modification).
page_count_regression.after_fix: Native CLI exit 2 with empty stdout; original full page count in the error. Native Rust tests cover 65536 and 65537 across all file/byte routes. Chrome covers 65537 across all four byte APIs, followed by valid-input recovery.
page_count_regression.count_validation: Raw FPDF_GetPageCount checked before pdfium-render u16 conversion; file path uses streaming custom access, without reading the whole file.

configuration_evaluation.scope: All seven DiffOptions fields, finite/range validation, positive Limits, checked OCR IR, page/block budget exhaustion and unchanged exact anchors at zero budget.
configuration_evaluation.unchecked_entrypoint: diff_documents remains available for already validated input.
configuration_evaluation.text_change_score: Recovers still-unpaired changes by pure text similarity; positional recovery remains independent.
configuration_evaluation.budget_behavior: Unscored ordinal fallback is split into removal/addition and flagged as alignment limited; CLI returns review code 3.

appearance_comparison.default: Enabled for file/byte comparisons; pure IR APIs retain text-only behavior.
appearance_comparison.changed_regions: Enclosing changed raster region projected back to each page PDF space; entire view box when raster dimensions differ.
appearance_comparison.incomplete_behavior: Skipped page and reason are returned when a budget or renderer limit is reached. CLI exits 3 if comparison coverage is incomplete.
appearance_comparison.identical_source: Exact equal byte inputs or equal file streams provide a stronger identity proof without rasterization. File inputs must remain immutable during comparison.
appearance_comparison.limitations: Raster resolution and white-background Pdfium rendering are the comparison profile, not arbitrary PDF object equivalence. Metadata preflight does not bound every internal decoder allocation or parse time.

widget_comparison.supported: Visible/hidden text scalars, field flags, checkbox/radio group scalar and direct SDK checked state, per-control export (including unchecked controls), combo/list first export and all selected indices/labels.
widget_comparison.regression: Public Listbox_SingleSelect stores foo/bar but displays Foo/Bar. Generic Pdfium field value API now supplies value; selected labels supply display_value. Verified natively with pypdf canonical/widget oracles and in native/WASM independent fixtures.
widget_comparison.additional_regression: Editable combos without an Opt dictionary are accepted. Custom checkbox export Yes -> Yep stays checked; unchecked controls changing only their export value are detected.
widget_comparison.buffer_checks: All widget names/scalars/button exports/option labels are checked before Rust allocation: <=2000000 UTF-16 units each, UTF-16/UTF-8 aggregate input-size budget, exact second-read size, terminator, strict decoding. Zero length is an SDK error, not an empty value. Aggregate recognized widgets plus all choice options <=100000 per document. Four unit tests plus native/WASM oversized-name/value fixtures.
widget_comparison.incomplete: Full XFA/hybrid semantics, orphan fields, signatures/actions, rich text, default-appearance/resource normalization and AcroForm-level semantics remain incomplete. Changed-source interactive documents require review.
widget_comparison.checked_state_regression: Reproduced the high-level wrapper returning false for a checked custom-export checkbox. Read SDK checked/export state directly after paired OnAfterLoadPage/OnBeforeClosePage notifications, avoiding high-level appearance-string allocation.
widget_comparison.canonical_extension: Basic AcroForm Fields trees now produce document-level changes, including unplaced values, full export arrays, option dictionaries, named branches and inherited FT/Ff/V/DV/DA/Q/MaxLen. UTF-16BE/UTF-8/PDFDocEncoding, dictionary order and Ff/Q defaults normalized. Failed analysis is not represented as field deletion. XFA hybrid AcroForm records remain available with a separate XFA warning. Unreadable top-level properties remain in unavailable_properties; comparable known changes remain visible. Identity/FlateDecode/ASCIIHexDecode text and JavaScript streams normalize to strings with strict integrity/work limits.

independent_structure_evaluation.methodology: Independent pypdf page count, MediaBox/CropBox intersection, cardinal rotation, raw dimensions, UserUnit and physical dimensions vs native IR; .001-point dimension tolerance and .000001 unit tolerance. Not text, painting or arbitrary malformed page-tree equivalence.

independent_text_audit.methodology: PDF.js with Unicode normalization enabled vs native per-page scalar inventories after NFC, explicit Latin ligature/long-s expansion and whitespace/control/soft-hyphen removal. Reading order and painting are not checked. Disagreements require adjudication; PDF.js is not ground truth. Each independent worker uses a 512MiB V8 old-space setting and 60s timeout; this is not a total RSS limit.

Audit eager object/xref stream integrity and interrupted SDK-cache publication, retaining bounded reads and explicit diagnostics.
Extend XFA XML, orphan fields, signature/action/rich-text/default-appearance/resource and document-level form semantics with independent gold.
Continue Unicode/clipping/CMap-resource adjudication and expanded natural-revision/reading-order gold.

unicode_diagnostics.collection: Raw SDK calls during the existing input precheck; same live SDK instance, validated geometry, <=2000000 characters/page and aggregate input-size work budget. Lazy one-bit-per-character error metadata; count/scalar fingerprint checked against extraction. No private Rust layout access or dependency fork.
unicode_diagnostics.readable_fallbacks: Printable fallback scalars retained; flagged control/whitespace/soft-hyphen/invalid scalars become U+FFFD. Run merging preserves counts.
unicode_diagnostics.comparison: Mapping errors and replacement characters mark text incomplete. Equal source bytes retain their stronger comparison identity proof. Changed sources require review even if rasters match.
unicode_diagnostics.limits: SDK flags indicate uncertainty, not original Unicode recovery. Some readable fallbacks agree with PDF.js despite SDK flags; unflagged wrong mappings also remain possible. The verified default SDK CMap override defect is fixed.

runtime_provisioning.default_and_bundled: One native verifier, pinned archive size/SHA-256 and library size/SHA-256. Cached files are rehashed before use. <=64MiB archive, <=128MiB expanded/library budget, HTTPS-only redirects, 60s request timeout, 75s install-lock timeout, atomic cache replacement.
runtime_provisioning.custom_overrides: PDFIUM_LIB_PATH and PDFIUM_BUNDLE_LIB intentionally select caller-provided SDKs outside the default SDK qualification.
runtime_provisioning.wasm: Pinned bblanchon classic Emscripten source wrapped as an isolated ES-module factory, exposing its function table and expected initialization alias. No eval or browser globals required.
runtime_provisioning.licenses: Notices verified from all eight native/WASM archives, decoded as UTF-8 with Latin-1 for legacy notice files, and included with source, native --licenses and generated WASM assets.
runtime_provisioning.platform_limit: macOS arm64 and Chrome/WASM executed here. Linux and Windows payload hashes verified; Linux CI configured but unexecuted, Windows execution unverified.

declared_unicode_gold.native: Passed on path and byte IR; public path/byte parity plus all-page text-layer parity.
declared_unicode_gold.browser: Passed exact full-page expected text in both native and WASM IR.
declared_unicode_gold.independent_fixture: ó€éê; later bfchar and bfrange override catch-all range. File/byte IR and text layers verified.
declared_unicode_gold.semantic_edit: ó€éê -> ò€éê changes only ToUnicode. Native file/byte diff and Chrome/WASM report one changed block with zero changed raster pixels.

canonical_form_evaluation.changes: canonical_form_changes at document scope; summary.canonical_form_fields_changed counts records separately from widgets. DocumentDiff.has_changes includes these records without invented page bounds.
canonical_form_evaluation.guards: Widget SDK preflight remains before additional parsing. Strict text and supported text-stream decoding; cycles/depth/count/work guards and per-stream expansion limits. Structural/identity errors disable the source snapshot to avoid false additions/removals. Property errors retain known properties and review reasons. Budget exhaustion fails the snapshot. These internal parser guards are not aggregate allocation limits; the supervised native CLI and opt-in typed byte client add the separate process budget profile. Direct in-process and WASM routes remain outside it.
canonical_form_evaluation.semantic_limit: Literal normalized property records, not proof of arbitrary form behavior or source equivalence. Signature bytes are not signature validation. XFA XML, orphan fields, full action/DA/resource and document-level form semantics remain incomplete. Unsupported property filters/parameters remain explicitly unavailable.
canonical_form_evaluation.xfa_hybrid_scope: All eight now have independently matching AcroForm inventories; XFA XML semantics still require review.

physical_unit_evaluation.supported_units: Positive finite values <=75000; missing page entry defaults to 1; UserUnit is not inherited. Bounded indirect numeric values supported. Parser/SDK geometry use floating-point representations.
physical_unit_evaluation.model: PageIr/PageSize/PageViewport expose optional user_unit. Coordinates, dimensions and font sizes stay in PDF user units. physical_size_points multiplies raw dimensions by known units; physical DPI and bitmap budgets incorporate units. DiffOptions position/font tolerances are physical points.
physical_unit_evaluation.unknown: Page-unit parsing failures or invalid values produce null user_unit and diagnostic counts. Fixed-width projection remains available; DPI rendering errors and changed-source comparison requires review. Equal source bytes retain the stronger identity proof. Legacy JSON defaults to Some(1).
physical_unit_evaluation.analysis_limits: 64MiB source, 8MiB individual expanded stream, <=200000 objects/work steps, tree/reference depth <64, SDK page count parity and strict subtree counts. The supervised native CLI and opt-in typed byte client add external worker budgets. Direct in-process/WASM isolation and portable hard memory enforcement remain incomplete.

process_isolation.api: isolation::run_pdf_worker for CLI arguments; isolation::IsolatedPdfClient for five typed byte operations.
process_isolation.publication: Anonymous stdout/stderr files are held until worker completion. Code 2 discards stdout; limits/crashes fail without a result. Raw CLI PNG destinations are atomically published after success. Typed requests and PNG responses use anonymous binary spools. Byte-operation directories close explicitly before return; cleanup failures are observable.
fault_gates: normal operation after a limited call
typed PNG payload counted in output budget
live Unix anonymous input has no directory entry
deep canonical response and exact float roundtrip

public_ir_audit.scope: Whole-document IR operations, not a maximum memory measurement for every rendering/comparison workload.

os_backends.macos: Executed: sampled RSS/physical footprint plus wait4 peak RSS; Unix CPU/file/core limits; parent-death watcher. Poll sleeps 10ms; scheduling/system-call latency and memory overshoot remain possible.
os_backends.linux: Implemented but unexecuted: RSS+swap from smaps_rollup, wait4 peak RSS, hard RLIMIT_AS plus CPU/file/core limits, PR_SET_PDEATHSIG and parent watcher.
os_backends.windows: Implemented but unexecuted: private/working-set/peak working-set monitoring and parent-handle watcher. Hard Job Object memory limits remain absent.

process_isolation.unix_file_guard: Kernel file-size ceiling is max(output budget,128MiB), respecting inherited hard limits, to also bound bursts while allowing SDK cache installation. Combined operation output is checked separately against the configured output budget. Core files disabled.
process_isolation.limits: Resource/crash containment, not filesystem/network isolation. Polling is not a portable hard memory ceiling. Parent staging/decoding/publication, OS I/O and aggregate host concurrency need deployment controls. Existing direct APIs and WASM remain outside native supervision.

typed_byte_audit.scope: Exact differential checks against direct APIs on immutable SHA-pinned data: whole IR, all normal-page text layers, first-page width=400/72DPI PNG and viewport, and harmless-rewrite comparisons. All operation directories empty afterward. 465 text checks comprise 455 normal pages plus 10 robustness requests. Observed child maxima are not worst-case child/parent memory bounds or independent semantic gold.

typed_protocol.input_budget: Per-file Limits.max_input_mb. Metadata/options checked before body copying; incremental reads do not allocate from a declared length.
typed_protocol.transport: Anonymous request/capture files. Unix link count zero checked before writing; Windows delete-on-close unexecuted. Compact JSON followed by raw PNG bytes counts toward combined output budget.
typed_protocol.coordinates: serde_json float_roundtrip preserves exact finite f64 values; regression comparisons use exact equality.
typed_protocol.staging: Parent staging is measured separately from child deadline. Parent decoding, OS I/O and aggregate host scheduling/resources remain outside child limits.
